Kya ply sach mein waterproof hoti hai? Barish aur paani se ply phool kar tootne lagti hai, jabki VAJRA PP shuttering sheet rehti hai 100% waterproof.

Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur slab par milta hai smooth concrete finish. Pan-India dispatch Raipur, Durg, Bhilai se uplabdh hai.
